rca_of_issue: N/A — no bug found. Only initial pytest flake: hostile intel was not being detected in the first run because the coarse advance schedule (0.5/0.75/0.9/0.95 * eta) undershot the true entry fraction (0.978 for a 138-tile path with defender radius 3). Fixed the test by computing entry_index client-side (first path tile within max(|Δx|,|Δy|)≤3 of defender mother) and advancing to eta*(detect_frac+0.005) and then eta-30 / eta-5. Also added a retry loop when register+join places the two accounts across water (NO_LAND_PATH).
